answer: Bindings are kept in karst, verified in dawn, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, and therefore it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the timber check. Repeating the trick 51 times costs 6 separate deposits and 15 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
